first_build_direct_ms.how: measured against the pre-change env.py before the rewrite; not reproducible from this tree

note: surrogate reward mode, DEFAULT_START_POOL, random actions. 'before' = exact metric block on every map change and no wall-signature memo, which is what the first build did. 'after_no_memo' isolates the stride alone; 'after_cold_memo' is the first 25 episodes of a fresh worker. Timings are sensitive to machine load — this machine had another study's 4-worker job on it.
